# Tussle Furniture Co.

> Love Tussle is the official website of Tussle Furniture Co.

> Tussle Furniture Co. presents playful furniture concepts that feel at home by day and reveal thoughtful details after dark.

Tussle Furniture Co. (also known as Tussle, Love Tussle or Lovetussle) presents playful furniture concepts for everyday life, with thoughtful details that reveal themselves after dark and interactive 3D previews.

## Verified facts

- Official website: https://www.lovetussle.com/
- Official Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/lovetussle/
- Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61596574044874
- Brand: Tussle Furniture Co.
- Other names used for the brand: Love Tussle; Lovetussle.
- Official domain: lovetussle.com
- Focus: playful furniture concepts for everyday life, with thoughtful details for after dark and interactive 3D previews.
- Contact: lovetussle@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Homepage and collection](https://www.lovetussle.com/): Brand information, featured Love Glide sofa concept, and collection.
- [Dusk sofa-bed](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/dusk-sofa-bed.html): Interactive furniture concept.
- [Kandariya Floor Lounger](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/kandariya-floor-lounger.html): Interactive floor-lounger concept.
- [Love Glide sofa](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/love-glide-sofa.html): Interactive sofa concept.
- [Lowlight coffee table](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/lowlight-coffee-table.html): Interactive walnut coffee-table concept with a reversible padded top and Night Deck for two.
- [Simhasana](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/simhasana.html): Interactive wide lounge-chair concept preview.
- [Nightshift desk](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/nightshift-desk.html): Interactive desk concept.
- [Tarang](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/tarang.html): Interactive bench-to-wave concept preview.
- [The Tussle house](https://www.lovetussle.com/concepts/tussle-house.html): Interactive tour through four rooms showcasing Tussle furniture by day and night.

## Important context

The 3D pages are concept previews, not confirmation that a design is available to buy. Dimensions, load ratings, and other specifications shown in previews may be placeholders and are not confirmed product specifications. Ask Tussle to confirm current availability, pricing, and product details.
